fresh_leads.qualification_text: Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are authorized to access information under this program/contract. Security Clearance Type: None/Not Required Security Clearance Status: Not Required Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? At RTX, our internships, co-ops and full-time careers provide an exceptional foundation to work on complex problems, advance your skills and create a safer, more connected world. Discover opportunities to make a difference at RTX. What You Will Do Join the Advanced Products & Solutions (APS) Mission Area within the Systems Engineering Center at Raytheon, where we design and develop advanced radar and early-warning sensor systems for the warfighter. We are seeking Radar Systems Engineer Interns who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical problems, and are eager to support innovative sensor and radar programs. You will work alongside experienced engineers to define system architecture, develop and verify system requirements, perform analysis and modeling, and support integration, testing, and flight activities across the full product lifecycle. Support development, analysis, documentation, and verification of system requirements using DOORS. Generate system CONOPS and system architectures. Assist with radar mode requirement development and system performance assessments. Conduct modeling, simulation, and data analysis using tools such as MATLAB, Python, and C++. Participate in hardware/software integration, troubleshooting, and hands-on laboratory testing. Support verification, validation, flight test, production, and post-deployment activities. Perform trade studies, functional/physical analyses, and MBSE-based system design. Prepare and present technical reports, findings, and briefings to internal and external stakeholders. Prepare and present technical reports, findings, and briefings to internal and external stakeholders. Qualifications You Must Have Must be pursuing Bachelor's or Advanced degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and actively enrolled through the completion of the internship/co-op session. Must have a minimum of 30 hours of credit by the start of the internship / co-op session. Experience with RF fundamentals: link budget analysis, modulation schemes, noise figure, gain, bandwidth, filtering, or wave propagation Experience with RF test equipment (spectrum analyzers, VNAs, signal generators) through coursework, internships, or lab work Experience using MATLAB for data analysis Experience may be obtained through on-the-job experience, research, coursework, or projects. Qualifications We Prefer Internship or project experience related to RF, wireless, radar, SDR, or satellite communication Knowledge of systems engineering architecture and design, integration and test, and verification and validation approaches Experience with programming using C++ or scripting/automation tools like Python or LabVIEW Hands-on experience with antennas or PCB layout for RF circuits Exposure to digital signal processing concepts What We Offer Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. The Mechanical Analysis and Test (MA&T) Department is responsible for ensuring structural and thermal design robustness across the Raytheon product portfolio. From preliminary concepts to fielded weapon-system support, MA&T delivers innovative structural and thermal engineering solutions. Our work spans classical, fundamental, and empirically based techniques as well as state-of-the-art finite element methods using industry‑leading commercial tools—all complemented and validated by testing executed to ensure cost-effective yet technically sound solutions. As an intern in the Analysis and Test Department, you will work one on one with a senior engineer, tackling the same structural and thermal analysis tasks assigned to entry-level engineers. You will be responsible for performing analyses and/or tests, participating in peer reviews, and generating final documentation. You will finish your internship knowing you contributed to the success of the Analysis and Test Department—and Raytheon as a whole.
